resolution.note: A lane rerun copies a task record the lead edited in the invoking checkout into the reused worktree, or refuses naming the divergence when both changed; test in lane-run.test.ts

title: A lane rerun carries a task record edited after the first run
body:
Why: the lead appended a rework note to t-8vk9p13 in the main checkout, then reran lane standards-pack, which reuses its worktree; the note never reached the lane's record and the merged record (d63a811) lacks it, so the lead's spec was lost from the durable record.
Outcome: a lane run that reuses its worktree carries the main checkout's newer task record into it, as lane start does (5802b3c), or refuses with a message naming the divergence.
Proof: lane-run test: edit the record after a failed run, rerun, the worktree record holds the edit.
